Join The Clubs for a lavish Thanksgiving Champagne Brunch buffet. Enjoy a variety of breakfast classics and traditional Thanksgiving favorites. Also featuring a New York Striploin Carving Station, made-to-order omelet station, and a delectable assortment of desserts.

Four seatings between 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM

**Cost:**
- Adults, ages 13 and older: $39.00
- Children, ages 4-12: $19.50
- Children, ages 0-3: FREE

**Please note:** All ticket purchases are subject to Eventbrite service and processing fees. These fees are visible before checkout – displayed alongside ticket prices – and are non-refundable.

[TICKETS ON EVENTBRITE](https://www.eventbrite.com/e/thanksgiving-champagne-brunch-at-the-clubs-at-quantico-tickets-1998989851457?aff=oddtdtcreator)
